knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic PO queue
knowledge.detail: Five fictional purchase orders with customers, contacts, ship-to, terms and line items for safe demos.

knowledge.name: Synthetic accepted quotes
knowledge.detail: Matching fictional quotes with prices, terms, ship-to, contact and buying group ground every validation.

knowledge.name: Configuration rule book
knowledge.detail: Compatible pairings, mandatory kits, region release rules and order type mapping drive each check.

intelligence_processing.name: Purchase order extraction
intelligence_processing.detail: Reads header and line fields from the PO exactly as written; nothing is inferred.

intelligence_processing.name: Quote validation
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares customer, contact, ship-to, terms and every line price with a 1% per-line tolerance.

intelligence_processing.name: Configuration checking
intelligence_processing.detail: Applies pairing, mandatory kit and region release rules to every sensor head on the order.

intelligence_processing.name: Order classification
intelligence_processing.detail: Derives region, order type, order class and sales channel from the PO and the quote.

intelligence_processing.name: Draft sales order assembly
intelligence_processing.detail: Builds header and lines at quote prices and lists every exception before entry.

intelligence_processing.name: Queue readiness review
intelligence_processing.detail: Separates ready orders from those needing a fix, each with the field or rule behind it.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the Draft agent with seven skills and two synthetic knowledge files; publish stays a separate approved step.

clients_user_interface.name: Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot access
clients_user_interface.detail: Gives sales operations a conversational entry point once approved production controls are configured.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file OrderEntryValidationAgent locally with deterministic, synthetic-only routing.

management_reporting.name: Pending queue view
management_reporting.detail: Shows every PO with value, matched quote and what to watch for.

management_reporting.name: Exception list per order
management_reporting.detail: Names each price, terms, buying group or configuration exception with its source field or rule.

management_reporting.name: Queue readiness summary
management_reporting.detail: Counts ready versus needs-fix orders so specialists work the ready ones first.

tools.name: Portable OrderEntryValidationAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with seven deterministic, read-only operations over bundled synthetic data.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the agent and exposes chat, health and tool-routing endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the seven-skill package in Draft; explicit authorized approval is required before publication.

tools.name: Microsoft Outlook
tools.detail: Cited production seam for the shared PO mailbox; the package reads a fixed synthetic queue instead.

tools.name: Dynamics 365
tools.detail: Cited production seam for accepted quotes; the package uses fixed synthetic quotes instead.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Uses only bundled fictional POs, quotes and rules; never browses or invents a field or price.

supporting_features.name: Extract, never infer
supporting_features.detail: Every PO field is read as written; missing values stay missing and become exceptions.

supporting_features.name: Wrong-configuration guardrail
supporting_features.detail: An order with a failed configuration rule is never presented as ready to enter.

supporting_features.name: No external side effects
supporting_features.detail: Never submits, books or changes an order and never contacts a customer.

supporting_features.name: Deterministic routing and validation
supporting_features.detail: Seven persona cases verify one bounded operation each with exact evidence anchors.
